page.layout: One page of title text, centred; a woodcut vignette in the centre below the lines; a library stamp and handwritten shelfmarks at the right, not transcribed.

main_text.l: Odit & rodit artem, quisquis ignorat artem.
Artificum vitia non imputanda sunt artibus.

page.notes: The first two lines are partly covered by a torn paper strip with handwritten "ET" marks; the word "CHRISTIANÆ" is partly obscured. The vignette shows a figure with a caduceus-like staff and a shield, within an ornamental border. Library stamp "Bibl. Eccl. Cathed. Trevir." and handwritten "DL 129" not transcribed. The "I" in "INSANOS" and "HOSTIVM" are set in spaced italic/roman mixture as printed.
